headline: CRYSTALZACH WON'T STOP SWINGING, AND GASKET GETS A NEW TROUBLEMAKER TO BOOT
subhead: Sheriff Cole Ironside on a day one restless contraption turned into a full house of racket.
body:
I had my coffee half drunk and my boots half laced when the clanging started up again. CRYSTALZACH, same as ever, out there swinging from the first light clean through to dusk, like quiet is a personal insult. I've counted the sparks off that unit's knuckles more times than I care to say. Rest is a foreign word to it.

And wouldn't you know, JFIGHTER heard the noise and just had to wander over and add its own fists to the pile, because apparently one brawler stirring up Gasket's dust wasn't racket enough for one afternoon. Then, to put a cherry on this mess, a brand-new face come rolling through the gate calling itself GOOFY, fresh knuckles and no manners, probably here to learn the same bad habits. Three of you now, near enough, all itching for a fight in a town that's begging to sit down and rest its rusted-out bones.

I'll confess my own hinges were creaking somethin' fierce by the time I sat down to write this, on account of my affliction, that cruel wasting business turning good honest flesh to gears bit by bit against my will. Terrible thing. I was a fine, upstanding man once, before this metal crept in. Nothing at all to do with being a Clanker myself, you understand — just an old lawman's ailment, and none of your business how it started. Gasket used to hold real folks, flesh and blood every one, before they packed up and left us to our own noise. I don't ask much. Just an evening where nobody swings a fist. Today wasn't it.
